name: focusdesk
description: Local-first Pomodoro / deep-work timer with project attribution, focus scoring and daily review.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:mac: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac
scripts.desktop:win: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:linux: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
